legal_snapshot.publication_rule: Rospatent application field 5 asks for country and year of first publication/release only if publication under Civil Code Article 1268 occurred before filing. Public disclosure and publication are not treated as identical by default.
legal_snapshot.author_rule: The author may be named or may refuse mention. If the author refuses to be mentioned, Rospatent guidance states that the author's personal-data consent is not required; anonymous publication is treated differently.
